description: A tower defense mode where players defend against waves of monsters. Towers can be upgraded through levels, and different monster types have varying HP and point values.

ConfigTowerlevel.description: Tower level definitions. Each level specifies the monsters that appear in that wave.

num.description: Monster composition for this wave [[monsterType, count, ...], ...]

ConfigTowerdefence.description: Tower defense tower upgrade definitions. Controls tower stats per level.

num.description: Numeric stat value at this level (e.g. damage, range)

point.description: Points awarded for killing this monster

wave_system.description: Towerlevel defines the monster composition per wave. Each wave ID maps to an array of monster spawns. Players must survive all waves to clear the level.

tower_upgrades.description: Towers (Towerdefence) can be upgraded using points earned from killing monsters. Each tower type has multiple levels with increasing stats and costs.

scoring.description: Monsters award points (Towermonster.point) when killed. These points are used both as score and as currency for tower upgrades (Towerdefence.point).
